description:
Inner Peace Music | Flute & Sitar | 1 Hour for Calm Stress & Healing Meditation

When the day has left you tense and scattered, peace does not have to be far away. Give yourself one quiet hour.

This peaceful Indian flute and sitar music is designed for inner peace and healing meditation: a gentle duet that slows your breath, softens stress and brings your mind back to stillness.

Enjoy 1 hour of bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) and sitar with soft tabla over a warm tanpura drone, with no vocals.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instruments: Bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) and Sitar, with soft tabla and tanpura drone
Raga: Yaman Kalyan (a serene evening raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental, meditative
Mood: Peaceful, warm, healing
Atmosphere: Sea air, soft evening light, a mind finally at rest
Duration: 1 hour

🎧 HOW TO USE
Sit or lie comfortably, close your eyes and follow the flute for the first few minutes. Breathe slowly and let the sitar answer each phrase. Headphones bring out the duet; soft speakers fill a room.
